name: Chuzhoy stsenary
source:
You are Alexander, an ordinary student archivist who suddenly wakes up in the body of a pioneer. But instead of trying to win the hearts of the girls, you will have to desperately fight for your own sanity. After all, this camp is a perfect prison without walls. It is an illegal, closed rehabilitation center where "inconvenient" teenagers have their memories wiped with drugs, turning them into perfect, smiling dolls for wealthy clients.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3723100515]Steam[/url]]
